task_title: Add speculative stacked-work metadata to epic control plane

plan_review.notes: 4 concerns found (2 critical, 2 major), all resolved: (1) post-merge stack_base simultaneously required+rejected — fixed by widening allowed set from unvalidated-only to all direct deps; (2) computeReady only gated on requires_main_rebase flag not on stacked_work presence — fixed to gate on node.stacked_work==null; (3) stacked_work.issue not audited on GitHub — fixed by adding stacked_work.issue to the auditIssue loop; (4) dependency_pr_number not validated against dep PR — fixed with new stacked.base-pr-mismatch check. Plan divergence=minor: no re-architecture, all fixes were detail-level corrections to the chosen design.
